basic_details.job_title: DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 28 Posts

application_fee.details: There is no application fee. No T.A / D.A will be paid for appearing in the Computer Practical Test and Walk in Interview.

age_limit.details: Age limit of the applicant should be between 25 to 45 years as on 01.01.2026.

qualification.details: Must be a permanent resident of the block for which applied. | Ex-banker and empaneled BRP from public or private sector banks who have at least 5-7 years of relevant field experience in micro or small enterprise segment in rural areas. Empaneled block / district level trainers (DLTs/BLTs), Chartered Accountants, Cost Accountants, MBA, graduates who are conversant with functioning of banks for micro-enterprise loans. Active women SHG member for last 3 years in the same block from the date of issue of notice. The applicant must be valid/registered voter as per the current electoral roll.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a Written Test
English & Math of Class X standard
how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official website at http://birbhum.gov.in or collect it from Gram Panchayat Offices, Sangha Samabay Offices of SHGs under Birbhum District, All Block Office under Birbhum District (at NRLM Section), or Office of the Additional District Mission Director, DMMU, Suri Birbhum.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Self-attest copies of the testimonials relevant to educational qualification, computer certificate, and experience.
Attach documentary evidence for all claims made in the application.
Submit the application in a sealed drop box at your respective Block Office under Birbhum District (at NRLM Section).
Ensure submission is made on any working day between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on or before 30 October 2026.
important_instructions: Engagement of the Mentor may be terminated or discontinued by the competent authority in case of non-performance, rude behaviour, misconduct, or any other unsatisfactory conduct. Applications must be submitted within the specified date and time in the respective block office drop box. Applications must be filled on the basis of fact which will have to substantiate with documentary evidence during selection, failing which candidature will be cancelled. No T.A / D.A will be paid for the tests and interview. Applications submitted anywhere other than the designated block office drop box or outside working hours will not be considered.

content_sections.text: A total of 28 tentative vacancies are available for Block Level Mentors across various blocks in Birbhum under the Enterprise Finance scheme.

content_sections.heading: DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Must be a permanent resident of the block for which applied. Ex-banker and empaneled BRP from public or private sector banks who have at least 5-7 years of relevant field experience in micro or small enterprise segment in rural areas. Empaneled block / district level trainers (DLTs/BLTs), Chartered Accountants, Cost Accountants, MBA, graduates who are conversant with functioning of banks for micro-enterprise loans. Active women SHG member for last 3 years in the same block from the date of issue of notice. The applicant must be valid/registered voter as per the current electoral roll.

rows.qualification_required: Graduate & above from a recognized University, with Diploma & above in Computer Application.

content_sections.heading: DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age limit of the applicant should be between 25 to 45 years as on 01.01.2026 .

content_sections.heading: DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee. No T.A / D.A will be paid for appearing in the Computer Practical Test and Walk in Interview.

content_sections.heading: DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Written Test, Computer Test, and Personal Interview. Carries 60 Marks, covering General Knowledge, English & Math of Class X standard, Reasoning, Current Affairs, and NRLM Concept etc. Carries 30 Marks, covering MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint. Carries 10 Marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website at http://birbhum.gov.in or collect it from Gram Panchayat Offices, Sangha Samabay Offices of SHGs under Birbhum District, All Block Office under Birbhum District (at NRLM Section), or Office of the Additional District Mission Director, DMMU, Suri Birbhum. Fill out the application form with all required details. Self-attest copies of the testimonials relevant to educational qualification, computer certificate, and experience. Attach documentary evidence for all claims made in the application. Submit the application in a sealed drop box at your respective Block Office under Birbhum District (at NRLM Section). Ensure submission is made on any working day between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Computer certificate Experience certificates and relevant testimonials Documentary evidence supporting eligibility conditions

content_sections.heading: DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Engagement of the Mentor may be terminated or discontinued by the competent authority in case of non-performance, rude behaviour, misconduct, or any other unsatisfactory conduct. Applications must be submitted within the specified date and time in the respective block office drop box. Applications must be filled on the basis of fact which will have to substantiate with documentary evidence during selection, failing which candidature will be cancelled. No T.A / D.A will be paid for the tests and interview. Applications submitted anywhere other than the designated block office drop box or outside working hours will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is DMMU WBSRLM Block Level Mentor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an offline recruitment drive conducted by the District Mission Management Unit, Birbhum, to empanel 28 Block Level Mentors on a contract basis under the Enterprise Finance scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 28 tentative vacancies are available for Block Level Mentors distributed across various blocks in Birbhum District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 30 October 2026 between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Block Level Mentor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate & above from a recognized University with a Diploma & above in Computer Application, along with satisfying specific banking, trainer, or active SHG membership criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 25 to 45 years of age as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Block Level Mentor recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled offline application form along with self-attested documents into the sealed drop box at their respective Block Office under Birbhum District (NRLM Section).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test (MCQ based) for 60 marks, a Computer Test for 30 marks, and a Personal Interview for 10 marks.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an examination date announced in the notification?
faq.answer: The exact date of the examination and tests has not been announced in the notification.
